The video mixes this footage with clips of news reporters and on-screen graphics displaying vote counts for ballot measures in California, Vermont, and Michigan.

on_screen_text.text: Vermont, Michigan, and California Voted on Constitutional Amendments to Enshrine Abortion Protections
PLEASE USE BLACK INK TO MARK YOUR BALLOT
MARCH LIKE YOUR FUTURE DEPENDS ON IT.

spoken_summary: A compilation of news reports announces that voters in Vermont, Michigan, and California have passed constitutional amendments to protect abortion rights. Reporters state that voters "supported protecting the right to abortion" and that the measures, like California's "Prop 1," will "enshrine reproductive freedom in the state's constitution." The victories are framed as a direct response occurring "some six months after the overturning of Roe v. Wade."
audio_music: An upbeat, rhythmic instrumental track plays continuously under the news clips, creating a tone of victory and positive momentum.
editing_pacing: A fast-paced montage with quick cuts between protest footage, B-roll of voting and government buildings, news clips, and informational graphics.
central_claim: Following the overturning of Roe v. Wade, voters in Vermont, Michigan, and California decisively passed ballot measures to constitutionally protect abortion rights, demonstrating that it is a winning political issue.
intended_effect: To make pro-choice viewers feel proud and motivated by these electoral victories and to showcase that the Democratic party's position on abortion is popular with voters.
